Third-party files in this folder (copied unmodified from the Potree 1.8 distribution
in web/lidar/potree, which is BSD-2-Clause, Copyright (c) 2011-2020 Markus Schuetz):

copc.js        - copc.js (https://github.com/connormanning/copc.js), MIT License,
                 Copyright (c) 2021 Connor Manning. Bundles laz-perf (below).
laz-perf.wasm  - laz-perf (https://github.com/hobuinc/laz-perf), Apache License 2.0,
                 Copyright (c) Hobu, Inc. LASzip-compatible decompressor.
zstd-codec.js  - zstd-codec (https://github.com/yoshihitoh/zstd-codec), MIT License,
                 Copyright (c) 2018 yoshihitoh. Wraps Zstandard (BSD License,
                 Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc.). Loaded only for "zstandard" EPT data.

ept-worker.js  - project code (not third-party).
